description: Rivest-Shamir-Adleman asymmetric cryptosystem used for key transport, digital signatures, and key exchange.
quantum_impact: Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm for polynomial-time integer factorization.
recommended_pqc_replacement: ML-KEM-768 for KEM / key transport; ML-DSA-65 or Composite Hybrid for digital signatures

key_size_concerns.2048: Classically acceptable until ~2030, vulnerable to CRQC (Cryptanalytically Relevant Quantum Computer).
key_size_concerns.3072: Classically strong (128-bit security), vulnerable to CRQC.
key_size_concerns.4096: Classically strong, vulnerable to CRQC, performance overhead.

quantum_impact: Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm for discrete logarithms over elliptic curves.
recommended_pqc_replacement: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) or Composite Hybrid ECDSA+ML-DSA

description: Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange mechanism.
quantum_impact: Vulnerable to 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' (HNDL) attacks via Shor's algorithm.

description: Classical finite field Diffie-Hellman key agreement.
quantum_impact: Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm for discrete logarithms.

description: Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm over Curve25519.
quantum_impact: Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm for elliptic curve discrete log.

description: Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm over Curve448.

quantum_impact: Classically deprecated and completely vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.
Grover's algorithm halves effective key strength: AES-128 drops to ~64-bit quantum security; AES-256 maintains 128-bit quantum security.
recommended_pqc_replacement: Transition AES-128 to AES-256-GCM for post-quantum resistance

description: Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (legacy block cipher).
quantum_impact: Classically weak (Sweet32 vulnerability) and further weakened by Grover's algorithm.
Classically broken collision resistance; unacceptable in signatures and certificates.
recommended_pqc_replacement: Migrate to SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA3-256

quantum_impact: Collision search cost drops to 2^128 using quantum algorithms, providing robust quantum security.
recommended_pqc_replacement: Post-quantum safe; retain or upgrade to SHA-384/512 or SHA3-256

description: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (NIST FIPS 203, based on Kyber).
recommended_pqc_replacement: Target standard for post-quantum key exchange / KEM

description: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (NIST FIPS 204, based on Dilithium).
recommended_pqc_replacement: Target standard for post-quantum digital signatures
